title: Strange deaths of abduction researchers, two John Macks hit by cars

tellings.quote: And if I recall, another guy named John Mack was hit by a car in the same day, right in in England.

plain: Tim Alberino, a filmmaker who tells stories of giants and the unexplained, speaks on Jesse Michels' podcast about a string of strange deaths among people who studied alien abductions, naming researchers such as John Mack, Karla Turner, Budd Hopkins and Barbara Bartholic. He says that, if he recalls rightly, when the abduction researcher John Mack was hit by a car in England, another man also named John Mack was hit by a car the same day. He tells it as an eerie coincidence hanging over the field.
